basics.name: Muhammad Rayyan
basics.label: PhD Student, Computer Science
basics.summary: CS PhD student at Tulane University advancing Medical AI, Multimodal Deep Learning, and Generative AI across complex multimodal clinical data. Investigating medical world models to simulate disease trajectories, forecast future clinical states and diagnostic outcomes, and learn from medical imaging.

work.name: Tulane University
work.summary: Developing multimodal 3D CT and clinical pipelines predicting PNET survival, progression, and grade (nested 5x5 CV AUROCs: 0.869, 0.841, 0.662), integrating focal lesion segmentation achieving a 0.35 tumor Dice score; expanding to the PANT cohort for external validation.
highlights: Investigating time-aware cardiovascular world models over large scale EHR trajectories to model latent disease state transitions and forecast prospective Major Adverse Cardiovascular Events (MACE).

work.name: Old Dominion University
work.summary: Generated large scale custom genomic datasets and benchmarked Sei, Enformer, and ChromBPNet architectures for predicting 21,907 chromatin profiles, reaching up to 0.977 AUROC for SEI, followed by 0.9437 and 0.9039 by Enformer and ChromBPNET.
highlights: Explored DNA foundation models including DNABERT, SPACE, and JanusDNA for predicting functional genomic events.

work.name: National University of Sciences and Technology
work.summary: Worked on 'Judgement Augmented Text-to-SQL via Natural Language Interfaces,' benchmarking instruction tuned models and enhancing reliability with a Llama 3.1 405B judge model for self correction.
highlights: Worked on 'A Multi Agent System for Unified Analytics over Heterogeneous Data Sources' using a LangGraph orchestrated system.

work.name: Telenor Microfinance Bank
work.summary: Worked on an e-commerce website using Java Spring Boot and Thymeleaf, implemented core functionalities with authentication features.

education.institution: National University of Sciences and Technology
highlights: Thesis: Analytica AI: Unified Cross Data Analytics via Multi Agent Systems

awards.title: Best Use of Data Award
awards.summary: Team 'Kepler's Horizon' won the award for Best Use of Data and was nominated for Global Judging.

awards.title: AWS Sponsored Scholarship
awards.summary: Selected as one of 1,000 students globally for the AI Programming with Python Nanodegree course.

publications.name: MCTS Guided Chunk Optimization with Beam Search for Retrieval Augmented Generation
publications.summary: S. Farooq, M. Rayyan, N. Iltaf, I. Islam. Developed a structured retrieval pipeline for RAG using efficient chunking, semantic filtering, and duplicate passage suppression to optimize context relevance.

publications.name: LLMs with Tools: An Empirical Evaluation of the Thought Action Observation Paradigm
publications.summary: M. Usman, N. Iltaf, M. Rayyan, T. A. Rana. Empirically evaluated TAO based tool augmented LLMs, analyzing tool selection, parameter extraction, execution success, and response integration.

publications.name: Multi Head Attention for Pulmonary Embolism Detection in CT Angiography
publications.summary: Z. T. Hussain, M. Rayyan, A. Gohar. Proposed MHA UNet to enhance detection of peripheral emboli in CT pulmonary angiography, outperforming standard baselines such as nnU-Net and Swin Transformer.

publications.name: Foveated ViT: Pre-Encoder Token Sparsification for Efficient Plant Seedling Recognition
publications.summary: M. Rayyan, N. Adnan, S. Fang, F. Abbas, M. Umar. Proposed Foveated ViT, utilizing a lightweight Scout Network to sparsify background tokens prior to self-attention layers, reaching 97.65% accuracy with 4.3M parameters.

publications.name: A Survey of Methods, Architectures, and Deployment Challenges for Large Reasoning Models
publications.summary: M. Rayyan, Z. Qadir, A. Hamza, M. Quddus, R. Khan, S. Younas, M. Usman, N. Saeed. Authored a comprehensive survey synthesizing core methodologies driving advanced LLM reasoning, covering reinforcement learning, search algorithms, and inference time compute scaling.

publications.name: Multiomics Reveals Epigenetic Control of Fibroblast Activity After Myocardial Infarction and a Key Role for RUNX Transcription Factors
publications.summary: Y. Li, X. Zhang, K. Ghimire, N. Khatri, L. Wang, Q. Liu, M. Shiri, M. Rayyan, S. Upadhayaya, B. Li, J. Francis, C. A. Simintiras, R. Li, J. Sun, X. Fu. Contributed to computational and functional genomic analysis in a multiomics cardiac repair investigation.

publications.name: Myofibroblast Contractile Machinery is Essential for Cardiac Repair after Myocardial Infarction
publications.summary: L. Wang, Y. Li, X. Zhang, Q. Liu, K. Ghimire, N. Khatri, M. Rayyan, J. Jung, J. Sun, X. Fu. Contributed to data processing and computational analysis evaluating cardiac repair mechanisms post myocardial infarction.

publications.name: Privacy Preserving AI Agent Architecture for Medical Calculators
publications.summary: I. Itrat, M. Rayyan, S. Sheikh, N. Bibi. Developed a Model Context Protocol (MCP) and small language model (SLM) based agentic framework for secure, privacy preserving clinical calculations.

publications.name: A Unified Multi Task Architecture for Joint Pancreatic Anatomy Lesion Segmentation and Tumor Grading
publications.summary: M. Rayyan, J. Hamm. Investigating unified multimodal volumetric architectures for simultaneous pancreas and tumor segmentation along with classification tasks.

publications.name: Dynamic Cardiovascular World Models for Adverse Event Forecasting from Longitudinal EHR Trajectories
publications.summary: M. Rayyan, J. Hamm, F. Han. Developing a time aware cardiovascular world model on large scale EHR trajectories to learn latent patient disease state transitions and dynamically predict major adverse cardiovascular events (MACE).

projects.name: AstroGPT-1.51B
projects.summary: Fine-tuned Qwen 2-1.5B using QLoRA on 22K tokens of handwritten astrophysics articles for improved specialized scientific text generation.

projects.name: ExCNET: Resource Efficient Attention Network for Seedling Recognition
projects.summary: Proposed ExCNET, an 8M parameter attention based architecture achieving 97% test accuracy on plant seedling recognition, outperforming heavier models including ResNet-50/152V2, VGG-16/19, DenseNet169, and ViT.

projects.name: 2D Multiple Objects Detection and Tracking for Autonomous Vehicles
projects.summary: Trained various YOLO models on the KITTI dataset, achieving high accuracy with YOLOv9t at 0.9798 precision and 0.7846 recall over YOLOv8n, 10n and 11n.

projects.name: ML for Splice Site Identification in Gene Expression
projects.summary: Systematically trained and evaluated 13 ML/DL architectures, achieving a top weighted F1 of 0.974 with an optimized SVM.
